_note: Final held-out test (Nov 14, 2026). None of these expressions are in the glossary or the few-shot examples. Proverbs/idioms marked source 'web' were collected from mwnlifestyle.com (Exploring the Moroccan idioms and proverbs; In Darija we say) and arabamerica.com (Proverbs in Moroccan Arabic that don't make much sense when translated into English), then put into a grandparent's sentence; 'common' = everyday grandparent expressions. Arabic spelling and gold meanings written by the assistant: the team must check them.

items.darija: اللي بغا العسل يصبر لقريص النحل أوليدي.
items.latin: lli bgha l3sel ysber l9ris n7el a wlidi.
items.meaning_en: If you want something sweet, you have to put up with the hard parts, my boy (keep going).

items.darija: اللسان ما فيه عظم، رد بالك آش كتقول لختك.
items.latin: llsan ma fih 3dem, rdd balek ach katgoul l khtek.
items.meaning_en: Words come out easily but they can hurt, so be careful what you say to your sister.

items.darija: اللي زربو ماتو، سوق بشوية أوليدي.
items.latin: lli zerbo matou, sou9 bchwiya a wlidi.
items.meaning_en: No need to rush, drive slowly, my boy.

items.darija: درتي ليا الطيارة فراسي بهاد الهضرة!
items.latin: derti liya tiyara f rasi b had lhedra!
items.meaning_en: You're making my head spin with all this talking! (playful)

items.darija: كون كان الخوخ يداوي كون داوى راسو.
items.latin: koun kan lkhoukh ydawi koun dawa rasou.
items.meaning_en: Someone who can't follow their own advice shouldn't give it.

items.darija: الخاوة حدها الدنيا، بغيو بعضياتكم.
items.latin: lkhawa 7edha ddenya, bghiw b3diyatkom.
items.meaning_en: Brothers and sisters only have this life together, so love each other.

items.darija: وريه وريه، وإلا عمى سير وخليه.
items.latin: wrih wrih, w ila 3ma sir w khellih.
items.meaning_en: Show him the way, and if he won't see it, leave him be.

items.darija: اللي عضو الحنش كيخاف من الحبل.
items.latin: lli 3eddo l7nech kaykhaf mn l7bel.
items.meaning_en: Once bitten, twice shy.

items.darija: جا يكحلها عماها.
items.latin: ja ykehhelha 3maha.
items.meaning_en: He tried to help and made it worse.

items.darija: ما يحك ليك ظهرك غير ظفرك.
items.latin: ma y7ekk lik dhrek ghir dfrek.
items.meaning_en: Only you can really solve your own problems; count on yourself.

items.darija: مية تخميمة وتخميمة ولا ضربة بالمقص.
items.latin: miyat tkhmima w tkhmima wla derba bl9ess.
items.meaning_en: Think it over a hundred times before a decision you can't undo.

items.darija: إلا كان صاحبك عسل ما تلحسوش كامل.
items.latin: ila kan sa7bek 3sel ma tl7souch kamel.
items.meaning_en: If your friend is kind, don't take advantage of them.

items.darija: الجمل ما كيشوفش حدبتو.
items.latin: ljmel ma kaychoufch 7debtou.
items.meaning_en: People see others' faults but not their own.

items.darija: ما تقلقش أوليدي، كلشي ديال الله.
items.latin: ma t9le9ch a wlidi, kolchi dyal llah.
items.meaning_en: Don't worry, my boy, it's all in God's hands.

items.darija: هادشي مكتاب أبنتي.
items.latin: hadchi mektab a benti.
items.meaning_en: It was meant to be, my girl.

items.darija: الكرش إلا شبعات كتقول للراس غني.
items.latin: lkerch ila chb3at katgoul lras ghenni.
items.meaning_en: Once you've eaten well, you're in a good mood.

items.darija: الله يكون معاك أوليدي فالسفر.
items.latin: llah ykoun m3ak a wlidi f ssafar.
items.meaning_en: May God be with you on your trip, my boy (safe travels).

items.darija: بصحتك الكسوة الجديدة، جات عليك زوينة.
items.latin: bse77tek lkeswa jdida, jat 3lik zwina.
items.meaning_en: Enjoy your new outfit, it looks lovely on you.

items.darija: الله يعطيك الصحة على هاد الكسكسو، بنين بزاف.
items.latin: llah y3tik sse77a 3la had lkeskso, bnin bzaf.
items.meaning_en: Thank you so much for this couscous, it's delicious.

items.darija: الله يهديك أبنتي، نعسي بكري.
items.latin: llah yhdik a benti, n3esi bekri.
items.meaning_en: Oh come on, my girl, go to bed early (gentle nudge).

items.darija: الله يجيب اللي فيه الخير.
items.latin: llah yjib lli fih lkhir.
items.meaning_en: Let's hope for the best.

items.darija: الله يكمل بالخير على العرس ديالك.
items.latin: llah ykemmel bl khir 3la l3ers dyalek.
items.meaning_en: I hope your wedding goes beautifully all the way.

items.darija: الله يستر، سمعت بلي كاين الثلج عندكم.
items.latin: llah yster, sme3t belli kayn ttelj 3ndkom.
items.meaning_en: Oh dear, I hope everything's okay, I heard there's snow where you are.

items.darija: عندك الزهر، ربحتي فالقرعة!
items.latin: 3ndek zzher, rbe7ti f l9or3a!
items.meaning_en: You're so lucky, you won the draw!

items.darija: الله يسامحك، نسيتيني هاد السيمانة!
items.latin: llah ysam7ek, nsitini had simana!
items.meaning_en: Oh you! You forgot about me this week! (affectionate teasing)

items.darija: الوقت صعيبة، ولكن الله كريم.
items.latin: lwe9t s3iba, walakin llah krim.
items.meaning_en: Times are hard, but things will work out.

items.darija: ما تبقاش تفكر بزاف، خليها على الله.
items.latin: ma tb9ach tfekker bzaf, khelliha 3la llah.
items.meaning_en: Stop overthinking, leave it in God's hands.

items.darija: بالشفا أوليدي، شرب الما بزاف.
items.latin: bchfa a wlidi, chreb lma bzaf.
items.meaning_en: Get well soon, my boy, drink lots of water.

items.darija: جيب صاحبك معاك، ما تحشمش، الدار دارك.
items.latin: jib sa7bek m3ak, ma t7chemch, ddar darek.
items.meaning_en: Bring your friend along, don't be shy, make yourself at home.

items.darija: راك ولد الناس، الله يحفظك ليا.
items.latin: rak weld nnas, llah y7fdek liya.
items.meaning_en: You're such a good, well-raised boy; God keep you safe for me.

items.darija: الله يرزقك بنت الناس.
items.latin: llah yerz9ek bent nnas.
items.meaning_en: May you find a good wife from a good family.

items.darija: العين حق، ما تبقاش تورّي التصاور ديالك للناس.
items.latin: l3in 7e99, ma tb9ach twerri tsawer dyalek l nnas.
items.meaning_en: The evil eye is real, don't show your photos to everyone.

items.darija: نعل الشيطان وتصالح مع ختك.
items.latin: n3el chitan w tsale7 m3a khtek.
items.meaning_en: Let it go and make peace with your sister.

items.darija: ناري! شحال كبرتي أبنتي!
items.latin: nari! ch7al kberti a benti!
items.meaning_en: Oh my goodness! How much you've grown, my girl!

items.darija: الله يخلف عليك على الفلوس اللي صيفطتي.
items.latin: llah ykhlef 3lik 3la lflous lli sifti.
items.meaning_en: Thank you for the money you sent, may God repay you.

items.darija: كبدي عليك أوليدي، بوحدك فالغربة.
items.latin: kebdi 3lik a wlidi, bou7dek f lghorba.
items.meaning_en: My heart aches for you, my boy, all alone so far from home.

items.darija: الضيف ضيف الله، دير ليه أتاي.
items.latin: ddif dif llah, dir lih atay.
items.meaning_en: A guest is a blessing, make him some tea.

items.darija: دير الخير وانساه.
items.latin: dir lkhir w nsah.
items.meaning_en: Do good and don't expect anything back.

items.darija: عيطت للطبيب، الموعد نهار الخميس مع العشرة.
items.latin: 3eyyet ltbib, lmaw3id nhar lkhmis m3a l3achra.
items.meaning_en: I called the doctor, the appointment is Thursday at ten.

items.darija: الما مقطوع، غادي نعيط ليك من بعد.
items.latin: lma m9tou3, ghadi n3eyyet lik mn b3d.
items.meaning_en: The water is cut off, I'll call you later.

items.darija: خالك جا البارح وجاب معاه الخضرة.
items.latin: khalek ja lbare7 w jab m3ah lkhodra.
items.meaning_en: Your uncle came yesterday and brought the vegetables.
